title: The Fourth, 2016 · after
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · the aggregator
logline: The morning after the pup's second Fourth: hoarse. He barks at a gull and nothing comes out. Gully's daughter, six, laughs so hard she sits down on the ramp. Wood draws the silence as a small empty balloon.

panels.composition: The dock in the morning. The PUP barking at a gull — an empty balloon.
